description: Shorti(쇼티) for «find videos of…» or «… 영상 찾아줘». Formats for words, a category or a pasted link. `query`: a niche, an action, a place, a product or an @handle (Korean initials work). `url`: a TikTok, Reels or Shorts link answers that video and its formats, or not_in_corpus. Strongest example first; song-only groups need `include_sound_groups`. This week's picks: shorti_what_to_shoot.

category.description: The creator's niche, when they have one.

include_sound_groups.description: Also list groups that share only a song.

lang.description: 'en' answers in Shorti's own English: never translate its Korean.

query.description: Words to find; empty lists by category.

name: shorti_find

field.description: the profession or team the words name: shorti_my_field answers its week

next_cursor.description: pass it back as `cursor` for the next page

product_fits.description: with no match on a format's own words: the formats whose videos carry a product like the words (a brand's line)

refusal.description: why nothing was answered, by name

state.description: 'not_in_corpus': Shorti has not read this video

video.description: the video a pasted link names
